source: NEXT-19. Machine-checked by pkg/gateway/api_contract_test.go (gateway) and per-SDK parity tests (sdks/go). Every SDK and client MAY rely on these shapes; changes are breaking and require a schema_version bump.

error_envelope.http: Every non-2xx JSON body uses this envelope — no bare strings, no nested deviations.
error_envelope.sse: Stream errors ride the SAME envelope as a data event: data: {"error":{message,type}}\n\n, always followed by data: [DONE].

success_body.chat.completion: id, object, choices[] non-empty; choices[0].message.content non-null; usage tokens are JSON numbers.
success_body.chat.completion.chunk: SSE chunks carry object=chat.completion.chunk; stream ends with the literal data: [DONE] line, including after errors.

pagination.consumers: Admin list endpoints (organizations, requests, keys); the dashboard client types pin this shape.

units.usd: All money crossing the API is a float named *_usd (cost_usd, cost_in_usd). Micro-USD (cost_microusd) is INTERNAL to ledger fixtures only and never crosses the API.

nullability.unknown_cost: A cost the system could not compute is null / absent — never 0 (0 is a real free/local cost).
nullability.content: assistant content is non-null on success; reasoning-only models still emit a (possibly empty) string.
